phase2.a8.apprenticeship.title: Request a workshop assessment
phase2.a8.apprenticeship.brief: Bring one repair question to the school careers desk. Ask for a supervised visit to the Nabapara repair workshop; no placement or licence is promised.
phase2.a8.study_bridge.title: Book a foundation study adviser meeting
phase2.a8.study_bridge.brief: Bring a recent homework page. Choose one topic to practise with the adviser and ask about foundation study and later adult bridge routes.
phase2.a8.community_practice.title: Ask about a community logistics placement
phase2.a8.community_practice.brief: At the school careers desk, ask to observe a supervised stock-and-delivery planning session. Agree hours that leave school and home commitments possible.
phase2.a8.retake.title: Talk with your teacher about next steps
phase2.a8.retake.brief: Meet your teacher at the Nabapara Vidyalaya office for 15 minutes to talk over ordinary Class XI next steps and school support. Attending is optional and carries no obligation.
phase2.a8.equipment.title: Apply for a practice-equipment allowance
phase2.a8.equipment.brief: Bring a list of equipment you would use to the school careers desk. Ask about terms and application evidence. The displayed envelope is not money in your wallet.
phase2.a8.licence.title: Request a supervised licence assessment
phase2.a8.licence.brief: Ask the careers adviser to review your hunter credential and explain supervision and eligibility. A tower credential alone does not grant a licence.
phase2.a8.patronage.title: Prepare a portfolio for review
phase2.a8.patronage.brief: Bring a piece of school or independent work. Ask the careers adviser which sponsorship review accepts it and what commitments a sponsor requests.
phase2.a8.public_portfolio.title: Decide whether to share your portfolio
phase2.a8.public_portfolio.brief: Meet the school adviser to review exactly which credentials and work would be public. Keeping the portfolio private remains a complete choice.
phase2.a8.scholarship.title: Request a scholarship interview
phase2.a8.scholarship.brief: Bring your credential portfolio to the school careers desk. Ask about interview dates, study requirements and support terms; an offer is an application opportunity.
phase2.a8.enterprise.title: Book a proposal assessment
phase2.a8.enterprise.brief: Bring a small service or workshop proposal. Ask the careers adviser about a supervised starting-capital review and its obligations; no loan is accepted here.
phase2.a8.strong.title: Make room after a strong result
phase2.a8.strong.brief: Talk with your class teacher after lessons about interviews and the school work you still want to do. You do not have to publish your rank or take a competitive path.
phase2.a8.middle.title: Choose a next step at your own pace
phase2.a8.middle.brief: Bring one tower observation to your class teacher. Compare an apprenticeship enquiry with a study bridge, then keep or change your ordinary school plan.
phase2.a8.poor.title: Ask for a practical next step
phase2.a8.poor.brief: Meet your class teacher after lessons. Choose a workshop enquiry, a foundation study meeting or community logistics practice. There is no remedial punishment and no requirement to fight.
phase2.a8.withdrawn.title: Talk through leaving the tower
phase2.a8.withdrawn.brief: If you want, tell your class teacher what made you stop. Earlier credentials remain on the result. Choose an ordinary school week or an application meeting without replaying the tower.
phase2.a8.deferred.title: Plan a school week without this year's exam
phase2.a8.deferred.brief: Meet the school office after lessons to ask about next year's examination and its age limit, or focus on class work. Deferral does not reserve admission or interrupt school.
phase2.a8.declined.title: Explore a route without the examination
phase2.a8.declined.brief: Ask the careers adviser about workshop apprenticeships and foundation or adult bridge qualifications. Continue Class XI; you do not have to register for another tower attempt.
phase2.a8.school.title: Return to your next school day
phase2.a8.school.brief: Open the school timetable and attend the next scheduled class. The calendar, stream and school closures still govern attendance; the tower result does not cancel lessons.
phase2.a8.study.title: Work on a homework question
phase2.a8.study.brief: Open the study desk at home or in the care home's study room. Choose a brief or ordinary study activity; existing deadlines and activity costs remain in force.
phase2.a8.rest.title: Leave room for rest
phase2.a8.rest.brief: Open the ordinary day planner and choose a rest activity when you want it. You can spend the following week at school and home without pursuing any tower offer.
phase2.a8.title: After the tower
phase2.a8.continuity: Class XI, friendships and life at home continue. These are optional next steps. Reading and planning cost no time.
phase2.a8.pending: A final tower decision is not available yet. Return to your current activity.
phase2.a8.rejected: That next step is unavailable. Refresh your plan or return to school.
phase2.a8.accepted: Opened your next step. A booking exists only when the destination confirms it.
phase2.a8.p4_strong_scholarship_intervie: Meet the visiting adviser from Bhagirathi State University in the Nabapara Vidyalaya office after lessons. Ask how a strong tower portfolio pairs with Class XII board marks for a scholarship interview; attending carries no obligation to apply.
phase2.a8.p4_strong_mentor.title: Draft a mentor term plan with Amrita Basu
phase2.a8.p4_strong_mentor.brief: Meet Amrita Basu in the Nabapara Vidyalaya staff room for 20 minutes to sort incoming invitations, pick one direction to explore, and name one enquiry to decline. Completing the session records your term plan on your next steps; no admission or funding is awarded here. Attending is optional and you may refuse or cancel with no obligation, keeping an unhurried Class XI week.
phase2.a8.p4_middle_coaching_scholarship: Enquire about a fee-waiver coaching scholarship

Speak to the Nabapara Vidyalaya careers adviser about the municipal evening study circle's fee-waiver scholarship for Class XI and XII students. Ask about seat dates and evening hours before deciding whether you want extra tuition.
phase2.a8.p4_middle_stream_review.title: Review your Class XI stream with Amrita Basu
phase2.a8.p4_middle_stream_review.brief: Meet Amrita Basu at the Nabapara Vidyalaya office for 25 minutes to compare Science, Commerce, and Humanities options for next term. Completing the session records a tentative stream and a preview note showing which next-term period it would add, without changing your current timetable or awarding admission. Changing direction is ordinary, and you may refuse or cancel with no obligation to keep your present stream.
phase2.a8.p4_poor_workshop_apprenticeshi: Complete a bench repair step with Debashis Pal

Work beside Debashis Pal at the Nabapara Lane repair workshop for 45 minutes to diagnose a small appliance and finish one hands-on step, either reseating a connector or securing its housing. Finishing the work records your completed repair step and a workshop reference from Debashis Pal; any talk of polytechnic bridges or apprenticeships is an enquiry only, with no wage, placement, or licence promised. You may refuse or cancel with no obligation, and ordinary school and home routines stay open.
phase2.a8.p4_poor_retake_prep.title: Join a practical study session at school
phase2.a8.p4_poor_retake_prep.brief: Join Amrita Basu and classmates in the Nabapara Vidyalaya library for a 40-minute practical study session focused on ordinary Class XI coursework. Attending is optional and you may leave or refuse with no obligation.
phase2.a8.p4_withdrawn_home_rest.title: Take an unhurried evening at home
phase2.a8.p4_withdrawn_home_rest.brief: Spend a quiet hour at home, or with the staff and residents at the children's home, over tea and supper, with no exam talk required. Stepping out of the tower takes judgement, and your evening belongs to recovery.
phase2.a8.p4_withdrawn_school_mentor.tit: Set a pacing plan with Amrita Basu
phase2.a8.p4_withdrawn_school_mentor.bri: Meet Amrita Basu at Nabapara Vidyalaya for 30 minutes, alongside a visiting note from Dr. Ananya Chatterjee's clinic, to choose either lighter evening study for two weeks or your usual rhythm and put any floor credential you already earned on your next-steps record. Completing the session records your chosen pacing plan and retained credential as a schedule note, with no admission, licence, or further examination sitting offered and no need to justify stepping out early. You may refuse or cancel with no obligation.
phase2.a8.p4_deferred_year_study_plan.br: Set aside a quiet session at your desk at home or in the care home's study room to balance Class XI lessons, rest and steady preparation for next year's examination. Deferring gives you a full year on your own terms.
phase2.a8.p4_deferred_community_voluntee: Enquire about volunteering with Dr. Ananya Chatterjee's clinic

Spend 30 minutes at the Nabapara Vidyalaya notice desk to submit an enquiry for Dr. Ananya Chatterjee's Community Clinic, choosing either the neighbourhood reading table or afternoon patient-card sorting around your classes and household routine. Completing the enquiry records your volunteer request and a proposed next-week calendar note; it is unpaid, carries no automatic enrolment or standing commitment, and does not book any examination sitting. You may refuse or cancel with no obligation.
phase2.a8.p4_declined_vocational_craft.t: Talk trade apprenticeships at the repair workshop
phase2.a8.p4_declined_vocational_craft.b: Meet Debashis Pal at the Nabapara Lane repair workshop after school to ask about electrical repair apprenticeships, polytechnic diplomas and neighbourhood shop work. Declining the tower leaves every ordinary craft and trade open.
Map a board-exam and civic route with Amrita Basu

Meet Amrita Basu at Nabapara Vidyalaya for 30 minutes to pair your Class XII board subjects with a local civic activity such as the neighbourhood reading table or neighbourhood records, and review direct degree pathways at Bhagirathi State University. Completing the session records your route sheet and a board-subject timetable note; university entry stays an enquiry rather than an award, and a full adult life requires neither a tower rank nor supernatural practice. You may refuse or cancel with no obligation.
phase2.a8.p407u.mentor.session: Amrita Basu sets your result beside the school timetable. You discuss managing pressure and where your retained evidence can be useful. Ordinary school, a later attempt, and leaving the tower behind remain open. The session ends with one manageable next step for the coming week.
